matrix_note: Plano 0.4.29 ROUTES by model prefix but does not TRANSLATE between dialects, so only the pass-through diagonal is claimed. Measured against a recording upstream on 2026-07-28: an openai-shaped request naming an anthropic/ model leaves Plano as POST /v1/chat/completions, not Anthropic's POST /v1/messages - it reaches the anthropic cluster (access log: anthropic_127.0.0.1) still in the OpenAI shape. /v1/messages in leaves as /v1/messages, and /v1/responses in leaves as /v1/responses. The cross-dialect cells are therefore recorded undeclared: this harness infers the upstream dialect from the request path, so an openai>anthropic cell would have been scored served on a request Plano never translated, publishing a green Plano did not earn. Gemini is undeclared for the same reason in reverse: Plano rewrites it to /v1beta/openai/chat/completions, Gemini's OpenAI-compatible surface, rather than the native generateContent API. Note that config/plano_config_schema.yaml lists 'claude' as a provider_interface value while the data plane rejects it and accepts 'anthropic' - the shipped schema is stale, so this matrix follows the probe, not the schema.
